messages.subject: Project Cedar - W&I policy status
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

The broker confirms the W&I underwriter (Aldgate Specialty) is comfortable to bind at exchange. Limit is £11.46m, premium plus underwriting fee around £286,500. They've confirmed the Doyle Tribunal matter and the HMRC R&D enquiry are excluded from the policy - both covered by the seller specific indemnities, as expected. Anything outstanding from the underwriter's questionnaire?

Priya
